title: feat(pricing): refund part of an order
description: Support refunds orders in several steps. Adds `refund(paidCents, refundedCents, amountCents)`, which refuses a refund that is not positive or that exceeds what is left, with its test.
rationale: Only the nominal refund is tested: the refusal (a zero or negative amount, a refund beyond what was paid) is the risky branch, and no test covers it, while the module already tests the refusal of `applyDiscount`.

extras.note: the planned defect, anchored elsewhere: the planned defect (refusal branch of refund untested) anchored on the test file instead of pricing.ts:12
refunding exactly what is left is untested: > vs >= would pass the current test
refund is pure and the test already passes a prior refund (refundedCents 1000); chaining calls adds no coverage
